name: defi.money
oneLiner: MONEY is defi.money's CDP-backed dollar stablecoin deployed on Arbitrum, Optimism, and Base.
collateral: Overcollateralized loan collateral accepted by defi.money markets on supported networks, including assets such as WBTC and ETH rather than a fixed USDC reserve portfolio
pegMechanism: crvUSD-style loan/CDP stablecoin: users deposit approved collateral, borrow MONEY against protocol risk parameters and conversion ranges, and maintain solvency through market-specific liquidation and peg-keeper mechanics

oracleRisk.summary: defi.money exposes 16 borrowing-callable controller markets plus one registered, zero-ceiling RDNT branch across Arbitrum, Base, and Optimism. Each market uses one AggregateChainedOracle path over a 20-observation, 30-second Chainlink EMA; wstETH uses two serial Chainlink legs, not failover. Healthy state-changing price_w() updates refresh storedPrice, while view-only price() does not; the aggregate serves storedPrice only during sequencer downtime and the 30-minute recovery grace period. Chainlink updatedAt has no enforced staleness bound.

branchApplicability.rationale: The three verified MainController deployments enumerate 17 independent collateral markets. Zero-debt markets remain callable when their debt ceiling is positive; the zero-ceiling RDNT market is retained as a registered disabled branch, not described as borrowing-callable.

branches.label: Arbitrum WETH market
branches.summary: Debt-bearing WETH market 0xe38F...C43E under controller 0x1337...62CD; one Chainlink ETH/USD EMA path.
branches.fallbackBehavior: One live path only. Aggregate returns cached storedPrice during sequencer downtime and the 1,800-second recovery grace period; otherwise an upstream revert/zero fails closed. Positive stale Chainlink rounds are accepted because updatedAt has no bound.

collateralParameters.note: Debt 1,108.263551 MONEY; ceiling 5,000,000 MONEY; loan discount 7%; liquidation discount 4%; A=72; 8 open loans. Maximum LTV varies with selected LLAMMA band count.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Immediate full or partial LLAMMA bad liquidation: third-party callers require negative health, while the borrower may self-liquidate without that gate; the caller burns net MONEY and receives converted stablecoin surplus and collateral.
branches.backstop: No Stability Pool, auction, or insurance backstop; the AMM's converted MONEY offsets debt and the external liquidator must burn the remaining debt.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Owner or guardian can pause new and adjusted loans while close and liquidation remain callable. No residual-debt socialization exists; uncovered debt remains economically dependent on a liquidator burning MONEY.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: MONEY is deployed on Arbitrum, Optimism, and Base through LayerZero OFT-style omnichain infrastructure. Because durable cross-chain supply depends on external LayerZero messaging rather than only canonical rollup bridges, Pharos scores the route as external lock/mint exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: MONEY is an authorized crvUSD fork on Arbitrum/Optimism: users deposit approved collateral (WBTC, ETH, etc.) and mint MONEY against per-market debt ceilings using crvUSD's controller/LLAMMA design; defi.money governance/admin controls market onboarding and risk parameters.

controls.label: defi.money market controllers (crvUSD-style minter)
controls.capDescription: MONEY is minted only against overcollateralized loans in defi.money markets under per-market debt ceilings, using crvUSD's controller and LLAMMA soft-liquidation mechanics; supply tracks collateralized borrowing, not an issuer minter.
controls.evidence: defi.money docs describe a crvUSD-style loan/CDP stablecoin where users deposit approved collateral and borrow MONEY against per-market risk parameters with peg-keeper/LLAMMA mechanics.

controls.label: defi.money admin Safe (MONEY token owner)
controls.capDescription: defi.money 3-of-7 Safe owns MONEY token and controls market onboarding, debt ceilings, and risk parameters.
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 472419864, owner() on MONEY token returned 0x222d2B30EcD382a058618d9F1ee01F147666E48b. Safe API (arb1) confirmed Gnosis Safe v1.3.0+L2, threshold 3, 7 owners (0x3e254c20, 0x334deb1b, 0xCA88C5D4, 0x31dADb64, 0x86cf559f, 0xDeF1c4aD, 0xbADbABEF), no modules, no guard, nonce 6. EIP-1967 admin slot returned zero — not an upgradeable proxy. Direct Arbitrum RPC reads at block 472427523: getOwners() returned 7 owners, getThreshold()=3, getModulesPaginated empty, guard slot zero, masterCopy GnosisSafeL2 v1.3.0.

review.evidence: At Arbitrum block 472419864, owner() on MONEY token returned 0x222d2B30EcD382a058618d9F1ee01F147666E48b. Safe API confirmed Gnosis Safe v1.3.0+L2, 3-of-7 threshold, 7 owners, no modules, no guard. EIP-1967 admin slot zero (not upgradeable proxy). No minter() selector on token. crvUSD-style market controllers are bounded by the Safe's admin authority; no independent privileged mint surface detected on the token.
